approved.reasoning: Correction against CE5-SA-R's order of 1 unit for RM 130 dated 2026-10-05 (s233). Sets cost from 60 to 64. It moves no cash and no stock: it changes what the row says about itself. The row is not rewritten here. The fold applies the patch, so there is one definition of what a correction does rather than two.
flags: RM 170 is recorded as paid against a row worth RM 130, so it would be RM 40 overpaid.
A cost typed here overrides what the inventory says this row drew, and it is what every margin on the row is then measured against.
CE5-SA typically pays about RM 110/unit for salt across 4 orders; this one is RM 130, 18.2% above that.
